title: FYTR HUB
subtitle: Sports & Events • Full-Stack Platform
imgAlt: FYTR HUB website: find fight nights near you
goal: FYTR HUB is a UK platform where fans find boxing, MMA, Muay Thai and other fight nights near them, and where gyms and promoters list their events. It needed to work for fans searching by location and for the hosts running each show.
challenges: Finding events by real distance from a town or postcode, showing fight cards with fighters, records and weights, and giving gyms and promoters their own tools. The team running the platform also needed a way to review accounts and listings, and to connect outside tools.
solutions: We built a full-stack Next.js platform on PostgreSQL with PostGIS for distance search and Mapbox for locations. Fans search by town, postcode or their current location and choose how far they will travel. Gyms and promoters get dashboards for events, fight cards, rosters and profile pages. An admin area handles host verification, reports and event listings, and a secure API lets outside tools publish events.
outcome: FYTR HUB is live at fytrhub.com, where fans can search for fight nights across the UK and gyms and promoters can list events for free.

title: StringMaster
subtitle: Education • Demo Web App
goal: StringMaster is a demo guitar learning platform we built to show how an online course business can teach through hands-on practice, not just video.
challenges: Making a guitar fretboard feel playable in a browser: it has to respond straight away, show exactly where the fingers go and still be clear on a landing page that also explains the product.
solutions: We built it with Next.js and TypeScript, with Clerk for sign-up and sign-in, and PostgreSQL with Prisma for data. Visitors can click a chord to see it on the fretboard, click frets to play notes with sound on or off, and play along to songs such as Greensleeves.
outcome: Open the demo to try the fretboard, the chords and the song player yourself. It is not a client project, so it has no client results to report. We can build the same kind of learning platform around your own lessons and pricing.

title: AlexFit Coaching
subtitle: Fitness • Demo Site
goal: AlexFit Coaching is a demo website we built to show how a fitness coach can present services and trainer profiles and take bookings online, in a modern, brand-focused site.
challenges: Balancing a clean, motivational look with scheduling and payment features, and keeping the site feeling premium without overwhelming visitors with too many options on the first screen.
solutions: We built a responsive site using HTML/CSS and JavaScript with a bold, fitness-focused design. The booking flow is simplified to three clicks, and a trainer spotlight section rotates featured coaches on the homepage.
outcome: Open the demo to try the layout, the trainer spotlight and the booking flow yourself. It is not a client project, so it has no client results to report. We can build the same kind of site around your business, with your real services and photos.

title: Spice & Savor
subtitle: Restaurant • Demo Web App
imgAlt: Spice & Savor restaurant web app screenshot
goal: Spice & Savor is a demo restaurant web app we built to show an engaging digital menu, online reservations and location details working together on a phone.
challenges: Building a visually rich menu that works well on mobile, with a reservation system that does not depend on a pile of third-party tools.

title: Pure Energy
subtitle: Food & Beverage • Demo Landing Page
imgAlt: Pure Energy smoothie brand landing page screenshot

title: Sparkle Clean
subtitle: Cleaning Services • Demo Site
imgAlt: Sparkle Clean cleaning services website screenshot
goal: Sparkle Clean is a demo website we built to show how a cleaning business can help visitors feel confident booking online, with instant quotes and clear service comparisons.
challenges: Earning trust through design: people are careful about who they let into their home or office, so reviews, guarantees and clear information need to be easy to find.
solutions: We developed a clean, professional site with a live quote calculator, a service comparison table and a testimonials section, using Formspree for contact submissions.

title: Affiliate Marketing Blog
subtitle: WordPress • Blog
goal: Create an SEO-optimized WordPress blog designed to generate affiliate income through product reviews, comparison articles, and tutorial content with ad integration.
challenges: Balancing SEO requirements with reader experience — the site needed to rank on Google while keeping readers engaged and clicking through to affiliate offers.
solutions: Built a custom WordPress theme with schema markup, optimized Core Web Vitals, and a strategic internal linking structure. Integrated Ezoic ads and Amazon Associates with custom placement controls.
outcome: The blog reached 15,000 monthly visitors within 4 months. Affiliate commission income grew steadily month-over-month, with top articles ranking on the first page of Google.

title: Sonic Audio
subtitle: E-Commerce • Shopify
goal: Design and develop a custom Shopify store for an audio equipment brand that needed advanced product filtering, quick checkout, and a mobile-first shopping experience.
challenges: Creating a fast, filterable product catalog with hundreds of SKUs without slowing down page load times, and integrating a seamless one-page checkout.
solutions: Built a custom Shopify theme with Liquid templates, implemented AJAX-powered collection filtering, and optimized the checkout flow to reduce friction. Added product video embeds and spec comparison tables.
outcome: Cart abandonment rate dropped by 18%. Average session duration increased by 40% thanks to the improved product browsing experience.

title: Helen May Coaching
subtitle: Business • Premium Growth Platform
imgAlt: Helen May Coaching premium platform screenshot
goal: Build a premium coaching platform that positions Helen May as a multi-industry growth expert. The platform needed to showcase services across different niches and integrate a smooth booking workflow.
challenges: Designing a cohesive brand experience across multiple service categories (career, business, personal growth) while keeping navigation simple and the visual identity consistent.
solutions: Developed a Next.js application with a modular component system. Each service category has its own landing section with tailored content, while unified booking and contact flows tie everything together.
outcome: The platform increased coaching inquiry submissions by 55%. Visitors spend an average of 4 minutes exploring different service categories before booking.

title: Dream Voyage
subtitle: Travel • Premium Blog & Discovery Platform
goal: Create an immersive travel blog and destination discovery platform with rich visual storytelling, destination guides, and a CMS that allows the author to publish content independently.
challenges: Balancing high-quality imagery and media with fast load times, and building a CMS workflow that a non-technical travel blogger could use effortlessly.
solutions: Built with Next.js and Sanity CMS for headless content management. Implemented lazy-loaded image galleries, interactive destination maps, and an easy-to-use rich text editor for blog posts.
outcome: The site loads in under 2 seconds despite rich media content. The client publishes 3–4 articles weekly without any developer assistance, and traffic has grown steadily through SEO.

title: AKKIRA
subtitle: Portfolio • Creative UX/UI & Web Design
goal: Design and develop a standout creative portfolio for a UX/UI designer that showcases their work through interactive case studies, smooth animations, and a unique visual identity.
challenges: Creating a portfolio that feels more like an interactive experience than a standard grid-of-work. Every animation and transition needed to feel intentional without hurting performance.
solutions: Used React with GSAP for scroll-triggered animations and page transitions. Each case study is a rich, immersive page with before/after sliders, process timelines, and live prototype embeds.
outcome: The client reported a 3x increase in inbound job inquiries after launching. The interactive case studies were specifically mentioned by multiple hiring managers as a deciding factor.

title: AI Skincare App
subtitle: Mobile • AI-Powered Application
goal: Build an AI-powered skincare analysis mobile app that uses computer vision to analyze skin conditions, provide personalized product recommendations, and track ingredient compatibility.
challenges: Integrating a computer vision AI model for skin analysis while keeping the app performant on mobile devices. Also managing a complex ingredient database with allergy and sensitivity filters.
solutions: Developed the app with React Native for cross-platform compatibility. Integrated a TensorFlow Lite model for on-device skin analysis and built a Firebase backend for user profiles and ingredient data.
outcome: The app achieved 4.6-star rating on both app stores. Users report high satisfaction with the personalized recommendations, and the ingredient checker has been praised for its accuracy.

title: FitTrack Mobile
subtitle: Mobile • Fitness Tracking Application
goal: Create a modern fitness tracking app that allows users to log workouts, track progress over time with visual charts, set goals, and stay motivated through streaks and achievements.
challenges: Designing an intuitive workout logging experience that works for both beginners and advanced athletes, while keeping the UI clean and uncluttered.
solutions: Built with React Native and Node.js backend. The workout logger uses a template system for quick logging, and the progress dashboard visualizes data with interactive charts using Victory Native.
outcome: Users log an average of 4.2 workouts per week. The streak feature increased 30-day retention by 35% compared to earlier versions.

title: Enterprise Dashboard
subtitle: Web App • High-Performance Analytics
goal: Build a high-performance full-stack analytics dashboard with real-time data visualization, role-based access control, and comprehensive admin management tools for a SaaS company.
challenges: Handling large datasets without sacrificing render performance. The dashboard needed to display real-time metrics across multiple data sources without lag.
solutions: Architected a Next.js frontend with a Node.js/PostgreSQL backend. Used WebSocket connections for real-time data updates and Recharts for interactive, customizable data visualizations.
outcome: The dashboard processes and visualizes over 100,000 data points in under 200ms. Client teams reported a 40% reduction in time spent on manual reporting.

title: MeloForge
subtitle: Music • AI / Web3 App
goal: Build an AI-powered music platform where listeners can track every listen, battle genre rivals, get AI song suggestions, and mint their sonic legacy as NFTs on Solana.
challenges: Bringing together AI-driven personalization, real-time listening analytics, and blockchain minting in one cohesive experience that feels effortless for everyday music fans.
solutions: Architected a Next.js application powered by Google Gemini for song suggestions and genre-rivalry matchmaking. Integrated Solana Web3 minting so users can tokenize their listening history and achievements as on-chain collectibles.
outcome: The platform ships a fully on-chain "sonic legacy" — users mint listening milestones as NFTs — while the Gemini-powered recommendation engine keeps listeners engaged session after session.

title: ResearchHUB
subtitle: Academic • Collaborative Web App
goal: Create a real-time collaborative research management platform that lets academic teams organize projects, share findings, and work together seamlessly from anywhere.
challenges: Designing real-time collaboration that handles concurrent edits, versioning, and role-based access without losing speed or overwhelming researchers used to simpler tools.
solutions: Built a Next.js frontend with an Express and Node.js backend. Implemented live document sync and activity feeds so every collaborator sees updates instantly, with granular permissions per project.
outcome: Research teams can manage the full lifecycle of a project — from proposal to publication — in one place, keeping every draft, note, and citation in sync while cutting coordination overhead.

title: A&B Cleaning Solution
subtitle: Commercial Cleaning • Business Site
imgAlt: A&B Cleaning Solution commercial cleaning website screenshot
goal: A&B Cleaning Solution needed a professional web presence to win commercial janitorial contracts across the Portland metro and SW Washington. The site had to showcase services like floor care, carpet cleaning, office janitorial, and pressure washing while making it effortless for facility managers to request a free estimate.
challenges: The commercial cleaning market in Oregon and Washington is crowded, so the site had to build instant credibility and rank locally across nine service cities. Mobile visitors - often managers calling between sites - needed one-tap access to the phone number and quote form without digging through pages.
solutions: Built a fast React single-page application with dedicated sections for every service, prominent click-to-call buttons, and free-estimate CTAs throughout. Added JanitorialService structured data with geo coordinates, opening hours, and full areaServed coverage so search engines understand exactly where A&B operates.
outcome: A&B now has a credible, modern storefront that ranks for local commercial cleaning searches from Portland to Gresham. Facility managers can call or request an estimate in seconds, turning organic search traffic directly into booked walk-throughs.

title: Lumea Glow
subtitle: Skin Clinic • Business Site
imgAlt: Lumea Glow skin clinic website screenshot
goal: Lumea Glow is a Registered Nurse-led skin clinic in Gladesville, Sydney. Jess needed a website that feels as calm and personal as her clinic, explains each treatment clearly, and makes it easy for new clients to book a consultation.
challenges: People need to trust an aesthetics clinic before they book. The site had to show that care is nurse-led, explain four areas of treatment without jargon, and help visitors who are not sure which treatment is right for them, all without feeling pushy.
solutions: A soft, editorial design with generous imagery and clear typography; treatment pages grouped into four areas of care; a Find My Treatment path for undecided visitors; membership information; and Book Now and call buttons always within reach. Built on WordPress.
outcome: In Jess's words: "Couldn't be happier with the final product!!" She has since come back for more work, which is the outcome we care about most.

title: Bouhan Falligant
subtitle: Legal • Law Firm Website
imgAlt: Bouhan Falligant law firm website screenshot
goal: Bouhan Falligant is one of Georgia's oldest full-service law firms, serving clients throughout the Southeast for over 130 years. The firm needed a digital presence that conveys that heritage and authority while making more than 20 practice areas - from maritime and admiralty to estate planning and commercial litigation - easy for prospective clients to navigate.
challenges: Organizing an unusually broad range of practice areas without overwhelming visitors, presenting dozens of attorney profiles consistently and professionally, and competing for visibility in one of the most competitive local search markets - legal services in Georgia.
solutions: Built on WordPress with a clear practice-area architecture, a filterable attorney directory with individual profile pages, and prominent click-to-call contact paths. A heritage timeline tells the firm's 130-year story, while structured SEO foundations help the firm rank for competitive Georgia legal searches.
outcome: A polished, authoritative web presence that reflects the firm's standing in the Southeast. Potential clients can identify the right practice area and attorney within seconds and reach the firm directly by phone, strengthening the pipeline of new matters.

title: DC Carpet Cleaning
subtitle: Carpet Cleaning • Business Site
imgAlt: DC Carpet Cleaning Australia website screenshot
goal: DC Carpet Cleaning needed a website that could turn local search traffic into booked jobs. The site had to clearly present carpet, upholstery, and stain removal services for residential and commercial clients across their Australian service area, and make requesting a quote effortless.
challenges: The cleaning industry is fiercely competitive online, so the site had to build trust quickly and stand out against national franchises. Customers typically visit on mobile while comparing quotes, so every page needed a clear next step and fast load times.
solutions: Designed a clean, conversion-focused site with dedicated service pages, before-and-after proof points, transparent pricing signals, and click-to-call plus quote request forms on every page. Local SEO foundations were laid out so each service suburb can rank individually.
outcome: A professional storefront that matches the quality of the service itself. Visitors can identify the right service, see the pricing approach, and book a clean in minutes - converting more of the traffic the brand already earns through word of mouth.
